roof.scope: Source-visible gable, separate central upper/lower red-tile slopes and curved right cap are modeled and bounded native review passed. Rear roof extent/radius/depth/scale are inferred, not independently surveyed.

size_proof.scope: All four final published assets have been read and matched to frozen SHA/byte counts, each strictly below100,000,000B. Raw/web190926tri and LOD83716tri; LOD actual bounds delta is reported separately, not a silhouette or whole-native geometry proof.

source_photos.scope: Both original licensed reference photos are byte-verified; existing independent actual-view and identity reports are retained. Neither photograph is embedded in any model.

texture_mapping_qa.scope: Intentional no-photo-texture model: actual raw/web/LOD GLB image tables are empty and original licensed photos remain reference-only. Frame inset is estimated20mm; this is not optical material calibration.

uncertainty.scope: The bounded native approval and source limitations remain explicit: simplified materials/weathering/clutter, estimated hidden sides/roof/radius/metric scale and closed/simplified balcony leaves. This registration preparation does not accept HTML rendering or citywide photograph-level detail. Subsequent static129 HTML acceptance is separately bound in browser_proof; dynamic catalog acceptance remains pending.

visible_facade_opening_grid.scope: Bounded visible-form v2 review supports left narrow/wide gable openings, angled return, recessed middle doorway and curved arched balcony opening.
